description: Polyphonic waveshaper carrying the five shaping curves from the Surge filter section.

params.text: Picks the shaping curve: none passes the signal through untouched, and the rest are tanh, hard, asym, sinus and digi.
Sets the gain driven into the shaping curve, -24dB to 24dB.

inputs.text: Adds to the Drive knob, 1dB per volt.
The signal to be shaped; the number of channels here sets the polyphony.

notes: the shaping runs in blocks of four samples, so it delays the signal by four samples.
this module is deprecated and hidden in the module browser; the Surge XT plugin replaces it, and both plugins can be used in one patch.
menu: Skins — a submenu of four colour schemes, listed by file name as Classic.xml, Miami.xml, NewYork.xml and Night.xml; picking one repaints every Surge module in the rack.
